set system host-name DeviceA.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment used to identify the equipment in the network.

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 172.16.0.1/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set routing-options static route 1.1.1.1.explanation: Configure the static route, specify the destination network and the next jump interface.

parameters.name: destination-network
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address of the destination network.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: The number of subnet masked bits of the destination network.

parameters.name: next-hop-interface
parameters.explanation: The name of the next jump interface to specify the transfer path of the package.
